primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Owner; printed p.14, PDF p.29
primary_records.original_meaning: Identifies the owner of the specific component using a list of point-of-contact structures.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the manufacturer, operator, custodian, access-control role or an independently verified legal title. A list of contacts does not establish ownership shares or intervals.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Parameter Version; printed p.14, PDF p.29
primary_records.proposed_label: Version of component configuration parameters not exposed through ISA
primary_records.original_meaning: Identifies the version of hardware/software configuration parameters that are not accessible via ISA; the source characterizes these as hard-coded values that traditionally do not change at runtime.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: The property reports a version; it does not expose the underlying parameter values or prove immutability. Do not equate it with Capability Version, Hardware Version, Software Version or the ISA specification version.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Program of Record; printed p.15, PDF p.30
primary_records.original_meaning: Represents the component program of record through a list of point-of-contact structures.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: The native representation is a POC list, not an acquisition-program identifier, funding record, procurement status or a second owner field. No programme membership or contact is inferred for an equipment example.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Software Version; printed p.16, PDF p.31
primary_records.proposed_label: Version of software running on the component
primary_records.original_meaning: Reports the version of the software running on the component.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a hardware revision, the version of inaccessible configuration parameters, an ISA specification version, an update command or a complete inventory of installed software packages.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Specification Version; printed p.17, PDF p.32
primary_records.proposed_label: Reported ISA specification version of the component
primary_records.original_meaning: Reports the ISA specification version with which the component complies.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: A declared version string is not independent evidence of conformance testing or certification. It is not the version of the component software, hardware or an OGC/CSAPI specification.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Support; printed p.17, PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: Identifies the individual or group to contact when non-maintenance support is needed, using a POC list.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Distinct from Maintenance, Manufacturer POC, Owner and Program of Record. It does not state service entitlement, support availability, contractual terms or an actual support request.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 String; printed p.50; PDF pp.65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Source atomic textual value. Identifier-specific grammar comes from UCI requirements, not a generic String assumption.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 POC; printed p.106; PDF pp.121–121
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Accepted extension requiring organization and optional name, phone, email and details. Additional details use Resource Descriptor with text/vcard media identification; source requires custom-type construction.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Resource Descriptor; printed p.110; PDF pp.125–126
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required resource type and URL, optional title/created/lastmod, and metadata name-value pairs. Inspected here for POC details and the transfer-versus-resource distinction.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Resource Type; printed p.111; PDF pp.126–126
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required primary/secondary media labels and a list of parameter name-value pairs; used as text/vcard in POC details.

sourceInspection.method: Original indexed DMS text, body extension marks and complete six definitions; original POC page 121 image and text inspected. Same-edition String and Resource Descriptor/Resource Type evidence reused from ISA-02.
sourceInspection.sourceStanding: Five accepted extensions and one core property; accepted extension does not mean already part of the core standard.

POC.construction: Source says non-standard composite, constructed using Custom Types.
POC.details: Optional accessible details follow the source vCard 3.0 / text-vcard description; not contact data embedded by inference.
POC.scope: No extrapolation to identity assurance, legal ownership, role authorization or procurement semantics.
